title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.12 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It adds a closed exact decision procedure for polynomial identities over Q: a claim-manifest 0.4 theorem schema can become gate-admissible only when a hash-bound certificate exactly matches the authoritative formal AST and symbolic sparse-normal-form replay yields the declared residual. General proof prose, external prover receipts, empirical declarations, and legacy manifest 0.3 theorem evidence remain non-admissible. Successful finite holonomy checks now emit a machine-readable boundary stating that source authenticity and scientific truth are not established. Release assets are built from the exact current-main annotated tag, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; indexed Knowledge bytes are not independently retrievable and are classified NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE rather than treated as a pending mathematical gate. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
